findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U1
findings.description: U1 (CY7C1049G-10VXI) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U1 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U1 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U1

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (BMDC3_SOJ32_Site) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J1

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1
findings.description: J1 (BMDC3_SOJ32_Site) has 1 ground pin(s) for 30 signal pins. Recommended: at least 8 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J1

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In2.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu

findings.title: Signal layer In2.Cu far from reference plane
findings.description: Signal layer In2.Cu is 0.68mm from nearest reference plane (In1.Cu). Tight coupling (0.1-0.2mm) reduces loop area and improves EMC.
findings.recommendation: Consider stackup adjustment to reduce signal-to-reference spacing.
findings.summary: Signal layer In2.Cu far from reference plane

findings.title: Signal layer B.Cu far from reference plane
findings.description: Signal layer B.Cu is 0.78mm from nearest reference plane (In1.Cu). Tight coupling (0.1-0.2mm) reduces loop area and improves EMC.
findings.recommendation: Consider stackup adjustment to reduce signal-to-reference spacing.
findings.summary: Signal layer B.Cu far from reference plane

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (12×28mm, εr=4.1) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 2682 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: A17

findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
